A UI flow's browser opens its page in a 1280x800 window, the size the product's own browser service opens one in, instead of headless Chromium's much smaller default. A step's screenshot captures the viewport rather than the full page, so a flow's frames now show what a user's pane would show rather than the top of the app, and the grade-time flow judge reads the app at the size it is delivered at. Both halves of the executor launch with the same flags, so box flows and the flow lab render alike.
